subject: MSStatsPTM peptide level data export and adjusted model

messages.author: 395fec07c2012bfa
messages.subject: MSStatsPTM peptide level data export and adjusted model
parts:
Hi,

Is it possible to extract the modified (STY) peptide level data with the adjusted model (FC and pvalue info) form the 'groupComparisonPTM' model or only the modified peptides with abundance from the summarized data? this will be useful for some downstream application, e.g. motif enrichment!

I have another query regarding the 'adjusted model'; what is the recommendation for reporting the modified sites? I mean, a site where a globalProtein is missing (Adjusted=false), is it recommended to take those for downstream reporting?

best regards,
Sudip

messages.author: 13904eb0f06097b0
messages.subject: Re: MSStatsPTM peptide level data export and adjusted model
parts:
Hi Sudip,

Not sure if you saw my comment yesterday, the platform deleted it for some reason. By default we do not produce a FC and pvalue for peptide level data. This can be done pretty easily by making the ProteinName column equal to PeptideSequence column before putting the data into the summarization function. Then you just run the workflow and the output will be the peptide level data.

In terms of the sites we could not adjust, this really depends on your specific use case. These modifications are still convoluted with changes in the global protein, so we cannot claim the effect is definitely due to the modification. However if you have a prior that the underlying protein does not change, you still might be able to draw downstream conclusions.

Let me know if any of this doesnt make sense.

Best,
Devon
